--help.stdout:
usage: eval.py [-h] [--json] {study} ...

Prospective development study, offline only. JSON stdout; JSON errors on
stderr.

positional arguments:
  {study}
    study     Prepare and analyze the offline development study.

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
  --json      Emit structured JSON (the default); help remains text.

study --help.stdout:
usage: eval.py study [-h]
                     {validate,export,plan,requests,truth-packets,review,adapt,score,precision} ...

positional arguments:
  {validate,export,plan,requests,truth-packets,review,adapt,score,precision}
    validate            Verify corpus/source hashes and expose independent-
                        review admission coverage.
    export              Export full frozen source universes with manifests
                        outside mountable views.
    plan                Prepare a counterbalanced all-attempt schedule,
                        without live admission.
    requests            Prepare schema-3 request templates; common fields
                        checked, runtime qualification pending.
    truth-packets       Prepare source-only independent truth review packets.
    review              Prepare arm-blinded answer packets from replayed
                        captures or explicit test fixtures.
    adapt               Replay original installed-plugin captures and retain
                        setup refusals.
    score               Score every scheduled attempt with explicit pending
                        review/missingness.
    precision           Compute prospective sample/precision diagnostics from
                        completed development judgments.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

study validate --help.stdout:
usage: eval.py study validate [-h] [--repo NAME=ROOT] [--export EXPORT]
                              [--truth-reviews TRUTH_REVIEWS]

Verify corpus/source hashes and expose independent-review admission coverage.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --repo NAME=ROOT      Explicit pinned repository root; repeat for all four
                        repositories.
  --export EXPORT       Previously verified source-only export directory.
  --truth-reviews TRUTH_REVIEWS
                        Independent frozen truth identity/semantic reviews and
                        adjudications.

study export --help.stdout:
usage: eval.py study export [-h] [--repo NAME=ROOT]
                            [--destination DESTINATION]

Export full frozen source universes with manifests outside mountable views.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --repo NAME=ROOT      Explicit pinned repository root; repeat for all four
                        repositories.
  --destination DESTINATION
                        Fresh output path with an existing physical parent;
                        never overwrite.

study plan --help.stdout:
usage: eval.py study plan [-h] [--study-id STUDY_ID]
                          [--repetitions REPETITIONS]
                          [--treatments TREATMENTS] [--cache CACHE]
                          [--destination DESTINATION]

Prepare a counterbalanced all-attempt schedule, without live admission.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --study-id STUDY_ID   Stable declared study identifier.
  --repetitions REPETITIONS
                        Declared paired sessions per case/arm, 1 through 10.
  --treatments TREATMENTS
                        Declared treatments; only baseline,product currently
                        qualified.
  --cache CACHE         Declared cache study; warm is refused until separately
                        qualified.
  --destination DESTINATION
                        Fresh output path with an existing physical parent;
                        never overwrite.

study requests --help.stdout:
usage: eval.py study requests [-h] [--plan PLAN] [--pin PIN]
                              [--destination DESTINATION]

Prepare schema-3 request templates; common fields checked, runtime
qualification pending.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --plan PLAN           Frozen offline schedule JSON.
  --pin PIN             Existing installed-plugin treatment pin JSON; does not
                        install or qualify it.
  --destination DESTINATION
                        Fresh output path with an existing physical parent;
                        never overwrite.

study truth-packets --help.stdout:
usage: eval.py study truth-packets [-h] [--repo NAME=ROOT] [--export EXPORT]
                                   [--destination DESTINATION]

Prepare source-only independent truth review packets.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --repo NAME=ROOT      Explicit pinned repository root; repeat for all four
                        repositories.
  --export EXPORT       Previously verified source-only export directory.
  --destination DESTINATION
                        Fresh output path with an existing physical parent;

study review --help.stdout:
usage: eval.py study review [-h] [--plan PLAN] [--export EXPORT]
                            [--bundle BUNDLE] [--fixture FIXTURE]
                            [--destination DESTINATION]

Prepare arm-blinded answer packets from replayed captures or explicit test
fixtures.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --plan PLAN           Frozen offline schedule JSON.
  --export EXPORT       Previously verified source-only export directory.
  --bundle BUNDLE       Adapted bundle JSON retaining original capture
                        references.
  --fixture FIXTURE     Explicit offline-scoring-fixture-v1 test data; never
                        original captures or agent evidence.
  --destination DESTINATION
                        Fresh output path with an existing physical parent;
                        never overwrite.

study adapt --help.stdout:
usage: eval.py study adapt [-h] [--plan PLAN] [--request-plan REQUEST_PLAN]
                           [--raw RAW] [--refusals REFUSALS]
                           [--study-kind {test-only,agent}]
                           [--destination DESTINATION]

Replay original installed-plugin captures and retain setup refusals.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --plan PLAN           Frozen offline schedule JSON.
  --request-plan REQUEST_PLAN
                        Prospective schema-3 profile plan with exact requests,
                        model and runtime pins; qualification pending.
  --raw RAW             Original capture directory; replayed offline, repeat
                        for every captured attempt.
  --refusals REFUSALS   Attributed setup-refusal JSON array, one record for
                        each refused schedule slot.
  --study-kind {test-only,agent}
                        Evidence class; agent is refused pending future
                        runtime admission.
  --destination DESTINATION
                        Fresh output path with an existing physical parent;
                        never overwrite.

study score --help.stdout:
usage: eval.py study score [-h] [--plan PLAN] [--export EXPORT]
                           [--bundle BUNDLE] [--fixture FIXTURE]
                           [--reviews REVIEWS]
                           [--review-packets REVIEW_PACKETS]
                           [--truth-reviews TRUTH_REVIEWS]
                           [--destination DESTINATION]

Score every scheduled attempt with explicit pending review/missingness.

options:

  --plan PLAN           Frozen offline schedule JSON.
  --export EXPORT       Previously verified source-only export directory.
  --bundle BUNDLE       Adapted bundle JSON retaining original capture

  --fixture FIXTURE     Explicit offline-scoring-fixture-v1 test data; never
                        original captures or agent evidence.
  --reviews REVIEWS     Attributed answer identity/semantic review document.
  --review-packets REVIEW_PACKETS
                        Frozen operator packet registry from study review;
                        keep bindings outside reviewer view.
  --truth-reviews TRUTH_REVIEWS
                        Independent frozen truth identity/semantic reviews and
                        adjudications.
  --destination DESTINATION
                        Fresh output path with an existing physical parent;
